uk-south-p1-mhclg-manor-farm-decision.summary: Decision letter of 10 June 2026 (186-page combined PDF with the Inspector's Report). On behalf of the Secretary of State the appeal by Manor Farm Propco Limited against Slough Borough Council's non-determination is allowed and planning permission granted, subject to the conditions in Annex B, for demolition of existing buildings and redevelopment to comprise a data centre (Use Class B8) and battery energy storage system with ancillary substation, offices, plant, emergency backup generators and fuel storage, landscaping, drainage, parking and access from Poyle Road, under application P/10076/013 dated 13 December 2024. Condition 1 requires commencement within three years. The Inspector's Report describes an 8.16 ha site west of Poyle Road with a northern Area A for the data centre (about 36,368 sq m GIA, 23 m parapet) and a southern Area B for a 100 MW battery storage system. Any High Court challenge had to be made within six weeks of the letter.

uk-south-p1-tritax-hy26-report.publisher: Tritax Big Box REIT plc (RNS regulatory announcement, as published by Investegate)
uk-south-p1-tritax-hy26-report.summary: Tritax Big Box's half-year report, released as an RNS announcement on 5 August 2026. Under 'Planning consent secured at Manor Farm' it says that in January 2025 the company bought the 74-acre Manor Farm site at Heathrow, within the Slough Availability Zone, and formed a 50:50 joint venture with EDF Renewables to deliver power from existing grid connection agreements: 107 MW in 2027 and a further 40 MW in 2029, supported by on-site battery storage. It says that on 10 June 2026 the Secretary of State for Housing, Communities and Local Government approved the proposal, 'which will enable us to begin site preparation works in the second half of the year', and that a pre-let with a potential occupier on a powered-shell basis is in solicitors' hands. The highlights list 'Planning consent secured for Manor Farm' and the '107MW Phase 1 Manor Farm pre-let'. Practical completion is expected in Q2 2028; data-centre capital expenditure in the half was GBP 1.6 million. It also names a second scheme at Chelmsford (125 MW of power, delivery expected 2029; formal marketing from July).
uk-south-p1-tritax-hy26-report.title: Tritax Big Box REIT plc: Half-year Report for the six months to 30 June 2026 (RNS, 5 August 2026)

additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 22 October 2026 against all 542 sites, 575 projects, 2,880 evidence records, 231 source records and the identity mapping of verified_construction_core/2026-10-22-research-thirtyfourth, every sources/*-holds.json file, the other queue fragments and claims.tsv, for Tritax, Manor Farm, Poyle, Wraysbury, Colnbrook, Propco, P/10076, 3366043 and Slough Availability. No match: the only 'propco' hits are Aligned's Pataskala parcel owner in Ohio and the only 'Tritax' hold is an unrelated Biggleswade sewage permit. No Atlas record lies within 2 km; the nearest are AWS Ridgeway, Iver (4.25 km north), Yondr Slough (5.84 km) and Iron Mountain LON-3 (8.58 km), all different sites and operators. Tritax's separate Chelmsford scheme is a different site in Essex.

locator.identity_review: The form names the site 'Manor Farm and land north of Wraysbury Reservoir', Poyle Road, Slough, the same site and application (P/10076/013) that the Secretary of State's 10 June 2026 decision allowed on appeal APP/J0350/W/25/3366043 by Manor Farm Propco Limited. Tritax's 10 June RNS links that decision as its Manor Farm data centre, and its 27 July RNS and 5 August half-year report describe the 74-acre Manor Farm site in the Slough Availability Zone. The applicant's air-quality assessment models the data centre's roof flue at (502919.75, 176291.37), 69.8 m north-west of the point in the same parcel. Esri World Imagery viewed locally (not redistributed) shows both points on the hard-standing and vehicle-storage parcel west of Poyle Road and south of the Poyle Channel woodland, as the Inspector's Report describes Area A. The SL3 0AA postcode centroid lies 174 m east, across Poyle Road on the trading estate, and is not used. No geocoder, map viewport or estate centroid is used.
locator.precision: Applicant-declared site point (easting 502958, northing 176233) on the planning application form for P/10076/013, published by Slough Borough Council as inquiry core document CD 1.1, converted to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (EPSG:27700 to EPSG:4326). It falls inside Area A, the northern parcel of the 8.16 ha appeal site that holds the consented data-centre building. It is not a building footprint, the red-line boundary or a surveyed position.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The application form publishes no positional accuracy, and the data-centre building's position relative to the point is shown only on plans without coordinates; the 8.16 ha application site extends a few hundred metres around it.

status.summary: Tritax Big Box's half-year report, published on 5 August 2026, identifies its Manor Farm data-centre scheme on the 74-acre site at Heathrow in the Slough Availability Zone: 107 MW of power to be delivered in 2027 (a further 40 MW in 2029), a 107 MW Phase 1 pre-let in solicitors' hands, site preparation expected to begin in the second half of 2026 and practical completion expected in Q2 2028. This dated company disclosure supports announced status as of 5 August 2026. Planning permission exists: the Secretary of State allowed appeal APP/J0350/W/25/3366043 and granted permission for application P/10076/013 on 10 June 2026, and Tritax reported on 27 July that the six-week challenge period ended without challenge. Both dates fall outside the 85-day window, so the consent is recorded as context and permitted status is not asserted. No site preparation, construction or occupier is established; the 2027 power, H2 2026 site preparation and Q2 2028 completion dates are forecasts.
